title: Parametric (p,q) torus knot (Three.js (Node.js))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Three.js (Node.js) that procedurally generates: Generate a tube mesh following a (p,q) torus knot curve (p and q winding numbers around the torus's two axes), swept with a circular cross-section of a given tube radius along the knot's path. p, q, tube radius, and path segment count must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
